title: Dispenser Hakkille mo sahaa mum alaa
intro: Neɗɗo tedduɗo, ganndiraaɗo hakkillaaji mum luggiɗɗi e wasiyaaji mum laaɓtuɗi, meeɗii rokkude wasiyaaji ɓurɗi yontaaji. Konnguɗi maɓɓe, binndaaɗi e defte ceniɗe, ina njiyloo yimɓe e yettoore, muñal, e jikkuuji peewal.
clues: Mi wasiyiima ɓiɗɗo am e bakkatuuji ɓurɗi mawnude: jokkondirde e Alla.
Mi jannginii ko fayti e teddeendi golle, hay ɓiɗngel muusngel, e no Alla yaltinirta ɗum.
Mi teeŋtinii yettude Alla e jibnaaɓe neɗɗo, jaɓde caɗeele nehdi cukalel.
Wasiya am ina waɗi tabitinde duwaawu, yamirde moƴƴere, haɗde bonannde, e muñde ko heɓotoo neɗɗo.
Suura e nder Quraan ina inniree am, ina waɗi janngirɗe am e janngirɗe ɗe ndenndu-mi.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
